title: Calendar Handoff Card
user: Families and small teams coordinating across calendar ecosystems who need a dependable, copyable event handoff when an invite is missed, blocked, or inconvenient to open.
recurrence: Calendar interoperability fails at the handoff point: recipients need one simple representation rather than another calendar migration.
current_workaround: Forward an ICS file, screenshot the event, manually type the time or meeting link into chat, or ask everyone to join the same calendar service.
smallest_useful_product: A local web tool that accepts pasted event fields or an ICS file and creates accessible plain text, a compact image/PDF card, timezone equivalents, joining details, and a minimal add-to-calendar link.
success_measure: 80% of recipients can identify the correct local time and joining link from the shared card without opening an ICS file; senders create a card in under 60 seconds.
constraints: Perform ICS parsing in-browser; make event links and descriptions opt-in in QR/image output; handle DST/timezone conversion deterministically; no tracking pixels.
